text:
[Council File 26-1157]
CD 1, CD 2
Housing Department revised report relative to amending the terms of the loan agreements with Los Angeles Family Housing for affordable housing projects Strong Residence and Harmony Place Apartments.

Yes

summary: The city would change the terms of its loans to Los Angeles Family Housing for two affordable apartment projects in Districts 1 and 2.
